planar.name: Display uniform compounds without flashing, compare the command below with antiview uc6 .
Make a compound of three triangular prisms, colour faces by part, then blend the result
planar.command: polygon pri 12/4 | off_color -f K | planar -d tile

planar.name: Same as above, but this time merge the faces instead of tiling
planar.command: polygon pri 12/4 | off_color -f K | planar -d merge

planar.name: Make a compound of four 5/2 star prisms, coloured by compound and blended using RGB. Edges and vertices are also blended
Same as above but edges and vertices are supressed in antiview
Same as above but modulo2 faces are made invisible
